Title: General availability: Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server supports PostgreSQL minor versions

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server now supports the latest PostgreSQL minor versions 11.14, 12.9, and 13.5. These PostgreSQL minor versions have many security and bug fixes. As part of your maintenance window, your servers will be automatically updated to this version.  

Learn more about PostgreSQL versions supported with Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server and review the list of supported regions where Azure Database for PostgreSQL—Flexible Server is available.
